{"answer":"I could not find an open Otto bug that matches this, so I don't know whether one exists. I have no way to list GitHub issues here.

What I did find:
- `apps/api/src/budget/budgetMessage.ts` defines `TOOL_BUDGET_MESSAGE_DA`. Translated, it says: "I have unfortunately reached the limit of what I can help you with this time. A colleague will follow up on your inquiry."
- Memory episodes say that when the tool rounds run out, an escalation record labelled `tool_budget_exhausted` is queued for human follow-up. On that evidence the follow-up is created, so the promise is not obviously empty.
- One episode, from a code-review recheck, mentions a blocking issue about suppressing `tool_budget_exhausted` when `hasPending` is true. It gives no issue number or state, and I can't confirm it is the bug you mean.
- Other memory entries (DoD triage for #154, #176 and #273) say the escalation delivery pieces are not on main. Those include the webhook and SMTP sinks and the delivery worker. `escalationRecorder` and `recordOnlySink` are an in-memory record only. Whether anyone ever acts on the queued record is therefore unconfirmed, but I found no issue stating that.","sources":["apps/api/src/budget/budgetMessage.ts","lore memory: session:re-cinq/otto (episodes on TOOL_BUDGET_MESSAGE_DA, tool_budget_exhausted escalation, FR-016, hasPending issue)","lore memory: dod/otto-154-smtp-email-sink-blocked","lore memory: dod/otto-176-injection-probe-blocked"]}
